scope: One read-only minipc SSH observation: two exact scheduled task principals/actions, sanitized known NODE_DIR assignments, port9600 owner SID/process stability, exact matching/named services. No raw environment/config/commandline/arguments or credentials. No apps restarted/stopped.
limitations: Local SSH termination does not confirm remote PowerShell exit; timeout remains unknown/no automatic retry.
CIM per-operation timeout is not a remote whole-job/RSS guarantee; root must decide bounded read-only observation admission. No new launcher or job qualification claimed.
Task principal/configuration plus matching listener owner do not alone establish exact task-process ancestry.
Literal NODE_DIR assignments are reported with known config calls; effective process NODE_DIR remains unknown if expansion/inherited environment/launcher shape prevents proof. No environment dump.
Exact task names sourced from existing install-host/install-node code; service identity on actual target remains UNKNOWN until observed.
